idea-plugin.name: Claude File Opener
idea-plugin.description:
Automatically opens files in the editor as Claude Code works on them.

When Claude Code (Anthropic's AI coding CLI) edits or creates a source file on disk, this plugin detects the change via IntelliJ's Virtual File System and opens the file in the editor — so you can follow along in real time without manually navigating to each file.

Works with all JetBrains IDEs (IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, PyCharm, GoLand, etc.). Only source files within the open project are opened; build artifacts, vendor directories, and .git folders are ignored.
